# Character Creator

Character creator: original characters for stories, games, comics and OCs, generated as portraits, full body art or turnaround sheets.

## What it does
Describe the character's look, clothes and personality, a style and a layout. Claude tells you the price and creates the design.

**How the files are made:** each character design is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files; ask for the same description again to keep a character consistent.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install character-creator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Character Creator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/character/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each character design uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The character designs show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_character_models` | Models for characters with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_character_cost` | Exact price of one character before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_character` | Starts one character in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_character` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A steampunk inventor girl, turnaround sheet"
- "An anime fire mage, full body"
- "A friendly robot mascot for a kids' app"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the character design (the description, the style and the layout) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
